text:
Julius Caesar was a key figure in the Roman Republic, which transitioned into the Roman Empire during his lifetime and shortly after his assassination. While he never officially held the title of "Emperor" (a title first held by Augustus), he ruled as a dictator and was the de facto supreme ruler of the **Roman Republic** (which became the **Roman Empire**).

Therefore, the empire ruled by Julius Caesar is the **Roman Empire** (or more precisely, the late **Roman Republic** transitioning into the Empire).
